statement: A plugin system initializes and registers event handlers. The system is supposed to load plugin modules and have them register themselves with an event registry. After initialization, the system sends a 'data_event' signal. Expected: 2 handlers respond, each adding an entry to a results log. Actual: only 1 handler responds (missing entries in log). When plugins are moved to load after registry setup, both handlers respond correctly. The handler registration is missing—one plugin's handler never gets registered.
